title: Live Update 1.42.0
body:
# Live Update 1.42.0

Raiders!

Update 1.42.0 has gone live, bringing a set of fixes, the second part of the Phantom Targets event featuring the Anomalia Outfit, a fresh Player Project, a smarter map condition schedule, and new Twitch drops.

# **HIGHLIGHTS**

* Phantom Targets Event & Phantom Targets Part 2 Raider Project

* The Tick Hunter Set is now available

* Improved Regional Map Condition Schedule

* An Update on Anti-Cheat and Fair Play

* New Twitch Drops (Car Freshener & Ceramic Vase)

* Rubber Duck Competition Winners

# **Phantom Targets Revealed**

With help from many Raiders, Shani has finally traced the origin of the phantom targets to erratic Wasps. These ARC units are behaving in ways she has never witnessed before: making odd noises, flying erratically, and carrying tech nobody can identify. All of them are converging on a single location. She now needs more help figuring out what's waiting for them there.

# **Improvements to Map Condition Scheduling**

We've been working to line up our Map Condition scheduling with how you actually play. As a result, we're rolling out Regional Map Condition Scheduling. From 1.42.0 onward, Map Conditions will be offset by region rather than following one single global schedule.

In practice, this means the timing will shift to line up with peak hours in each region, giving you a better shot at experiencing the conditions no matter where you're playing from. This should reduce the chances of missing a map condition regardless of your location.

Let us know how the Regional Map Condition schedules feel by reaching out to us on Discord. We want to hear about everyone's experience so we can fine-tune things further.

Note: the Map Condition tracker on the website will be updated to reflect this change soon. Until then, be aware that the information shown there may not match what you see in-game.

# **Following up about Fair Play**

Time for an update on Fair Play since our last conversation a few weeks ago. A few new issues, along with some familiar ones, have come up since then, and we want to reaffirm that keeping Topside free of cheaters and exploits remains one of our top priorities, and will stay that way.

## **A Note on Third Party Software**

Whenever we receive reports of third-party software being used to gain any kind of advantage, whether in-game or at the account level, we look into it. Our first step is always confirming whether the report is accurate and whether the software genuinely does what it's claimed to do. Often these claims don't hold up, and engaging with this kind of software comes with significant risk. Downloading unverified, unofficial software can endanger more than your account. Beyond a ban and losing access to the game, it could expose your personal data and information.

Your account security is only as strong as its weakest point. To protect your account, purchases, and progress, we strongly encourage enabling 2FA or passkeys on every external account linked to your Embark ID. And never, under any circumstances, share your login details with anyone, no matter how many ducks are offered in exchange.

## **Recent Actions & Future Plans**

Over the last few weeks, we've made a number of improvements in partnership with Anybrain and Denuvo Anti-Cheat. This led to swift enforcement against a large batch of accounts using recently popularized cheat software.

We're also focused on making sure serial, blatant cheaters face permanent sanctions. Work continues on ways to make it harder for new accounts to be created by banned users, discouraging cheaters from coming back.

We've also improved our ability to detect accounts involved in what we call "economy exploits," allowing us to sanction offenders faster. Sanctions of this kind have been ongoing.

On top of that, several initiatives are running in parallel to tackle teaming and general matchmaking abuse. We understand how much a consistently fair experience matters, and we know that in certain regions or at certain times, it's more common to encounter groups forcing their way into lobbies to grief other players. More details will come once these initiatives are ready.

That's not the full picture either. We'll keep expanding all of these efforts and do everything we can to keep your time across the Rust Belt fun, exciting, and above all, fair.

# **Congratulations to the Winners of the Rubber Duck Design Contest!**

Last Thursday, the three finalists of the Rubber Duck Design Contest were chosen by popular vote on our Discord. We've already started bringing these ducks into the game, and they'll be added in a future update. Before long, you'll be able to decorate your Raider Den with ducks designed by the talented gekko.rar, im_AshCheeks, and nassguhl.

# **Content and Bug Fixes**

## Audio

* Refined indoor footstep and movement sounds: removed scuff sounds, improved audibility at a distance, and updated occlusion and concrete surface cues.

* Improved footstep audio when walking through foliage for a clearer, more natural feel.

* Added distinct footstep sounds for movement across plastic cloth and tarp surfaces.

* Added unique firing sounds for all Tier 3 magazine upgrades.

## Gameplay

* Fixed stomp attacks from the Queen and Matriarch that could sometimes hit through walls or land from a much greater distance than intended.

* The Photoelectric Cloak now provides protection against Turbine lightning attacks and Matriarch missiles.

* Added spawn protection to the Surge Coil Trap so it no longer affects players as they spawn in.

* Added the ability to rebind Quick Wheel slots.

* Fixed the Dolabra, Hullcracker, and Rascal so they now deal damage correctly in the Practice Range.

## Map

* Fixed an issue with a zip line in Buried City that couldn't be interacted with, by repositioning it so it can now be used properly.

## Performance

* Improved the UI texture streaming cache for better memory efficiency and reliability.

## Stability

* Fixed several crashes and made various stability improvements.

## UI

* Fixed project tiles that incorrectly displayed "Part X completed" on projects that don't have parts.

* Corrected spelling errors and updated localized text across multiple languages.

* Polished matchmaking error messages to make them clearer.

* Fixed the "Claim" shortcut button in the logbook so that completed project quests now correctly take you to the associated project page.

* Added a Region label to the Map selection screen showing your current Matchmaking region.

# **KNOWN ISSUES**

* We continue investigating reports of crashes on XBOX Series S. We apologize for the inconvenience and thank you for your reports. We'll share updates as soon as we have more information.

* We're aware of crashing issues on PC linked to Windows Update KB5121003. Please refer to our shared workaround while we work on a permanent fix.

* Players on Epic may experience a sudden loss of keyboard input.

* While we investigate this, we recommend disabling any active Overlay. You can also try alt-tabbing out of and back into the game.

* The Projects tab shows a sticky notification dot.

* The throw animation may occasionally fail to play when trying to detonate a Trigger 'Nade immediately after throwing it.

* The weapon swap animation may look broken if you swap weapons right after vaulting.

* Player animations may appear broken when a search of the Baron Husk is interrupted.

* Shredders float to the ceiling in some rooms of the Hidden Bunker.

* Leapers can jump through the ARC Turbine.

* Items that grant Merits will incorrectly display a Merits icon when brought into a Raid.

* Shots fired while riding ARC may sometimes fail to register.

* Some doors allow player flashlight beams to pass through instead of blocking the light.

* We're aware of clipping issues affecting the Triumph, Reaver, and Azimuth outfits.

* Old Ermal offers may appear available in the "Acquire and Craft" menu, though this is visual only.

See you Topside, //Ossen & Raz
